{{Quote|THE SPIRITS OF THE LOST WILL DESTROY YOU ALL!|an inscription that was scratched by Queecon into a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] pane on Nub Saar|<ref name="In the Name of the Maker">{{LivingForce|Jigsaw: In the Name of the Maker}}</ref>}}
'''Nitram Con Queecon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ranat/Legends|Ranat]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Queecon alone lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], in the deserted floating city of [[Nub Saar]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he encountered the [[Heroes of Cularin]], when they traveled there.

==Appearances==
*{{LivingForce|Jigsaw: In the Name of the Maker}} {{1st}}
